title: Sombr 2026: Here’s Where to Shop Affordable Last-Minute Tour Tickets Online
summary: The singer-songwriter's You Are The Reason Tour features dates across the United States until the end of November.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

Sombr is on the road this fall in support of his debut album I Barely Know Her . The tour has less than 20 dates left throughout the United States with dates in Detroit, Cleveland, Milwaukee, Philadelphia and other cities. It ends with two dates at Madison Square Garden on Monday (Nov. 23) and Tuesday (Nov. 24).

The remainder of the tour has a rotating lineup of openers in support of the singer-songwriter, including The Last Dinner Party, Hannah Jadagu and Dove Cameron.

Shop Sombr Tour Tickets at Ticketmaster

Tickets to the tour first went on sale through Live Nation and Ticketmaster , while the retailer’s Face Value Exchange program is an option for fans to resell tickets.

However, many of the dates have either sold out or are very close to selling out, so one of the best ways to find last-minute Sombr tickets online is through third-party sites, such as StubHub , Vivid Seats , SeatGeek , TicketNetwork , Gametime , Event Tickets Center and others. All online retailers guarantee authentic tickets in time for your concert. Prices may be above or below face value at times.

Where to Find Sombr: You Are The Reason Tour 2026 Tickets Online

EDITOR'S PICK

Find Sombr Tickets at StubHub

find tickets at StubHub

Top choice for concert tickets.

StubHub has all-in pricing, so all fees are listed upfront. The site’s “FanProtect Guarantee” ensures that tickets are valid and delivered in time for the concert. If not, you’ll get your money back. In addition, if the concert is canceled and not rescheduled, you’ll receive 120% credit or be offered a full refund without the extra credit. At the time of publishing, Sombr tickets start at $71.

EARN REWARDS

Find Sombr Tickets at Vivid Seats

FIND TICKETS at Vivid Seats

Vivid Seats lets you search by type of seat, such as suite, standing room, front of section or the VIP section, while the retailer prioritizes “Super Sellers” who are “experienced, highly rated sellers.” With Vivid Seats, your purchase is protected with the company’s “100% Buyer Guarantee,” which ensures that you receive legitimate tickets in time for your concert or your money back.

PROMO CODES

Find Sombr Tickets at SeatGeek

FIND TICKETS at SeatGeek

Tickets are delivered digitally via email, so they’re available on your phone before you go through security. And prices are surprisingly reasonable, even for the hottest tickets. For example, SeatGeek has cheap Sombr tickets online from $47. Use our discount code BILLBOARD10 to save an additional $10 at checkout.

PROMO CODE

Find Sombr Tickets at TicketNetwork

find tickets at TicketNetwork

TicketNetwork has ticket packages, which include parking passes, VIP access, meet and greets and other great experiences. It has tickets to Sombr concerts with all-in pricing that lets you see exactly what you’ll pay up front (fees included). Tickets start at $83, as of this writing. You can use our exclusive code BILLBOARD150 to save $150 off purchases over $500, or BILLBOARD300 to save $300 off orders of $1000 and up.

And since TicketNetwork is a resale site, the company says that pricing may sometimes be below face value because tickets aren’t held to a specific price point. It guarantees that the tickets you receive are the ones you purchased, and sometimes, even better than expected.

SEATING OPTIONS

Find Sombr Tickets at Gametime

find tickets at Gametime

Gametime is a stellar third-party retailer for fans looking for affordable tickets. Tickets for in-demand concerts like Sombr start at $57. It guarantees the lowest prices, event cancellation protection and on-time ticket delivery for a smooth ticket-buying experience.
